refactor(styles): group CLARITY styles by family and harden Swan shell runtime (#177)

* refactor(styles): group CLARITY styles by family and harden Swan shell runtime

Move feature styles from per-feature packages to clarity/{feature} with a
single clarity_feature_styles workspace package, and teach the bundle
builder and STAC CLI to compile per-feature artifacts under that package.

Prefer bundled shell host styles, gate bottom navigation until shell
surfaces hydrate, and allow releaseTrust TTL refresh when signing keys are
unchanged.

* fix(swan): keep cached trust and rehydrate shell on manifest cache hits

Fall back to persisted releaseTrust when inline manifest trust fails instead
of discarding the last verified bundle, and mark shell surfaces hydrated when
serving an in-memory manifest for the active scope.
